flags.why: The colour is lemon yellow, as given in the [Cambridge dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-vietnamese/lemon), rather than lime yellow.
Vàng chanh describes a lemon-yellow shirt, rather than a lime-yellow one.
flags.fix: She wore a bright lemon-yellow shirt.

flags.why: Vá vỏ is predominantly Southern usage and needs a regional label.
The crab name is regional to coastal Northern Vietnam, as documented in [Wiktionary](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/v%C3%A1i_gi%E1%BB%9Di).
Vê đúp remains a current name for W, including in [Vietnamese language research](https://ssh.vnuhcmjournal.com.vn/index.php/ssh/article/download/461/852/), so dated is misleading.
